hero.eyebrow: Fakatotoloʻi ʻo e Vai ʻi he Potó
hero.paragraph: ʻOku ʻoatu ʻe he HydroLedger ki he ngaahi ʻapi nofoʻanga ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala fakaʻaho ʻo e fakaʻaongaʻi ʻo e vaí, totongi fakataha ʻoku mahino, pea mo e ngaahi fakatokanga ʻi heʻene liki — kotoa ʻeni mei ha tēpile puleʻanga ʻe taha.

features.headingPrefix: Meʻa kotoa ʻoku fiemaʻu ki he
features.paragraph: Tukuange e founga motuʻa ʻo e totongi tatau. ʻOku tokoni ʻa e HydroLedger ke tuʻu maʻu ʻa e faitotonu ʻi he fakaʻaongaʻi ʻo e meʻangaue mo e tekinolosia.

items.title: Fakatotoloʻi Fakaʻaho ʻo e Vai
items.text: Fua totonu ʻa e fakaʻaongaʻi ʻo e vai ʻi he miniti kotoa pē ʻi he ngaahi ʻiuniti taki taha ʻo ʻikai falala ki he ngaahi ʻamanaki fakaʻavalisi.

items.title: Totongi Aotometiki ʻo e Komiuniti
items.text: Faʻu ʻa e ngaahi fika totongi ki he kau nofo ʻo fakatatau ki heʻenau fakaʻaongaʻi moʻoni. Toʻo atu ʻa e faingataʻa ʻo e totongi fakataha.

items.title: Fakatokanga ʻi he Liki
items.text: Ngaahi fakatokanga aotometiki ʻi he taimi pē ko iá ke ʻiloʻi ʻa e ʻalu ʻa e vai ʻoku ʻikai ke angamaheni mo taʻofi ʻa e maumau lahi ʻi he ngaahi miniti, ʻo ʻikai ko e ngaahi māhina.

items.title: Tufa ʻo e Totongi ʻi he Fakamaau
items.text: Muimuiʻi ʻa e fakaʻaongaʻi ʻo e feituʻu fakataha pea tufa ʻa e totongi ʻi ha founga mahino ke langa ai ʻa e falala mo e fakahaofi vai.

howItWorks.heading: Fokotuʻu Faingofua, Ngāue ʻo ʻikai Fie maʻu Lima
howItWorks.paragraph: Fokotuʻu fakavavevave. ʻI he hili ʻa e fehokotaki ʻa e ngaahi naunau, ʻoku tokangaʻi ʻe he palatifōmú ʻa e ngaahi fika faingataʻa, fekau ʻo e fika totongi, mo e ngaahi fakatokanga ʻo e liki.

steps.title: Fehokotaki ʻa e Ngaahi Mita Potó
steps.text: ʻOku fakapipiki ʻe heʻemau kau tekinisiane ʻa e ngaahi mita fakaʻaho poto ki he ngaahi paipa vai ʻi he loto ʻapi ʻi he lalo miniti ʻe 15.

steps.title: Fakatotoloʻi ʻi he Taimi Toʻo
steps.text: ʻOku ʻalu hokohoko ʻa e fakamatala ki he HydroLedger cloud, ʻo lekooti ʻa e fika totonu ʻo e fakaʻaongaʻi pea siofi ʻa e ʻalu ʻo e vaí.

steps.title: Aotometiki e Ngaahi Fika Totongi
steps.text: ʻI he ngataʻanga ʻo e māhina, ʻoku fakatahaʻi ʻe he misini ʻa e tufa ʻo e feituʻu fakataha mo e ngaahi fika mei he mita taki taha ki ha fika totongi ʻoku mahino.

portalPreview.headingPrefix: Fakamālohia ʻa e Kau Nofo ʻaki ʻa e
portalPreview.paragraph: ʻOku langa ʻe he mahino ʻa e uouangataha ʻa e komiuniti. ʻOku fiefia ʻa e kau nofo ʻi he ngaahi tēpile faingofua ʻoku ʻoatu ai ʻa e fakamatala totonu, fika ʻo e ʻamanaki totongi, mo e fakatokanga ʻo e liki.
portalPreview.tipText: ʻOku hā ngali ʻoku ʻi ai ha vai ʻoku ʻalu maʻu pē mei hoʻo tepi kīseni ʻi he pongipongi. Ko hono vakaiʻi e ngaahi fakamāhuʻi vai ʻe lava ke fakahaofi ai ʻo aʻu ki he kalani ʻe 10 ʻi he uike.

audienceSplit.residentHeading: Fakamaau, Totongi ʻo fakatatau ki he Fakaʻaongaʻi
audienceSplit.residentParagraph: Tuku ʻa e totongi maʻa e fakaʻaongaʻi lahi ʻa e kaungāʻapi. Totongi pē ki he kalani ʻokú ke fakaʻaongaʻi, ʻo poupouʻi ʻe he fakamatala moʻoni ʻi he tēpile.
residentBullets: Fakamatala totonu ʻo e mita taki taha ʻi he māhina kotoa pē mo e ngaahi fika totongi mahino.
Ngaahi fakatokanga ʻi he SMS & telefoni kapau ʻoku ʻiloʻi ha liki iki ʻi he ngaahi meʻangāue.
Founga totongi fika faingofua mo vave fakataha mo e ngaahi tohi fakamoʻoni aotometiki.

audienceSplit.adminHeading: Fakahoko ʻo e Ngāue mo e Mapuleʻi ʻo e Maumau
audienceSplit.adminParagraph: Fakaliliu ʻa e puleʻi ʻo e ngaahi naunau mei ha kaveinga faingataʻa ki ha founga faingofua mo tupu lahi fakataha mo e totongi aotometiki.
adminBullets: Fakahoko ʻo e tufa ʻo e naunau ʻoku fehokotaki fakahangatonu ki he ngaahi ʻiuniti taki taha.
Ngaahi fakatokanga fakahoko ʻi he taimi pē ko iá ke taʻofi ʻa e maumau lahi ʻi he vai.
Fakamatala fakaikiiki ʻi he tēpile fekauʻaki mo e mita lahi vs kalani ʻo e tufa.

testimonials.heading: Meʻa ʻoku lea ʻaki ʻe he kau Pule ʻo e Ngaahi ʻApi

quotes.text: ʻOku liliu ʻe he HydroLedger ʻa e founga ʻo e ngāue. Naʻa mau ʻiloʻi ha ngaahi liki lalahi ʻe tolu naʻe ʻikai ʻiloʻi ʻi he ngaahi paipa naʻe fakahaofi ai ʻa e ₹11 lakh ʻi he ʻuluaki kuata.
ʻOku tupu ʻa e falala ʻa e kau nofo. Ko e totongi ʻi he fakaʻaongaʻi moʻoni ʻo e vai ʻo ʻikai ko e fika lahi ʻo e mita fakataha naʻe fakaleleiʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi kē ʻo e kau nofo.

items.q: ʻOku fiemaʻu nai ke tāmateʻi ʻa e vai ke fokotuʻu ʻa e ngaahi mita poto?
items.a: ʻIkai. ʻOku fakapipiki ʻa e ngaahi mita ʻo ʻikai fie maʻu ke fakaava e paipa. ʻOku fakaʻosi e ngāue ʻi he ngaahi miniti ʻo ʻikai fie maʻu ke tāmateʻi ʻa e vai ki he kau nofo.

items.q: ʻOku anga fēfē ʻa e tufa ʻo e totongi vai fakataha?
items.a: Ko e vai fakataha (hangē ko e vai ʻi he loto lotoʻapi) ʻoku toʻo ia mei he mita lahi ʻi he kamataʻanga. ʻOku tufa leva ʻa e toenga ʻo e totongi ʻi ha founga mahino.

items.q: ʻOku vave fēfē ʻa e ʻiloʻi ʻe he HydroLedger ʻa e liki?
items.a: ʻOku vakaiʻi ʻe he sisitemi ʻa e ʻalu ʻo e vai. Kapau ʻoku ʻikai ke tuʻu ʻa e vai ʻi he miniti ʻe 10, ʻoku vave ʻa e ʻoatu ʻa e fakatokanga ke fakasiʻisiʻi ʻa e maumau.

items.q: ʻOku tokangaʻi nai ʻe he HydroLedger ʻa e maluʻi ʻo e kau nofo?
items.a: ʻIo. ʻOku maluʻi ʻe he HydroLedger ʻa e fakamatala ʻo e kau nofo ʻi loto ʻi he ngaahi hala ʻoku maluʻi ʻaki e kouti. Ko e fakamatala ʻo e ngāue ʻoku tauhi pē ke fakatotoloʻi ʻa e fakaʻaongaʻi vai.

cta.pill: Kau ki he HydroLedger ʻi he ʻaho ni
cta.heading: Kamata Fakatotoloʻi hoʻo Fakaʻaongaʻi Vai he ʻAho Ni
cta.paragraph: Fakaʻaiʻai ʻa e fakahaofi, fakafaingofua ʻa e totongi, pea maluʻi ʻa e ngaahi naunau nofoʻanga. Tuku ke mau fikaʻi hoʻo tupu fakapaʻanga fakakomiuniti.

footer.tagline: Founga tufa vai poto mo e fakatotoloʻi ʻo e fakaʻaongaʻi ʻi he nofoʻanga. Maluʻi ʻa e ngaahi sisitemi, fakatonutonu e totongi, fakahaofi e vai.
